summary: Frontend testing of 3 changes: (1) Original library images for skins, (2) Speed halved (minSpeed=1.25, maxSpeed=4.8), (3) Subway Surfers style animation. All features verified working correctly.

All 12 image files verified to exist in /frontend/public/images/
skins.js correctly references original library image paths
Speed - minSpeed=1.25 verified in code (was 2.5, now halved)
Speed - maxSpeed=4.8 verified in code (12 * 0.8 * 0.5 = 4.8, 20% less then halved)
Speed progression - still over 120 seconds (speedProgress = elapsedSeconds / 120)
Character animation - legCycle implemented (Math.sin for leg swing back/forth)
Character animation - armCycle implemented (Math.cos for arms pumping opposite to legs)
Running animation - legs pumping back and forth with legSwing amplitude 0.5
Running animation - upper and lower leg segments with knee bend
Jump animation - legs tuck up based on tuckAmount calculation
Jump animation - arms go up during jump (ellipse shapes at -pH*0.15)

Animated legs visible below character sprite (cyan/green color visible in screenshots)

Game playability - slower pace confirmed via score progression (manageable gameplay observed)
Guardian image displays correctly during gameplay
